title: Here’s How Markets Closed After the Supreme Court Heard Tariff Arguments
summary: U.S. indexes finished higher Wednesday afternoon, with a rebound in AI stocks helping lift the Nasdaq composite 0.6%.   Strong earnings and optimism from U.S. companies also spurred gains, with a rally in Amgen and Caterpillar shares lifting the Dow.

title: With sales booming, front-runner Amgen says US biosimilar market is already working
summary: With its biosimilars business thriving, Amgen is in a unique position to comment on U.S. biosimilar policy as the current administration introduces reforms to increase the availability of the copycat drugs. As officials discuss easing biosim regulatory standards, Amgen execs shared a word of caution—and also optimism about being able to adapt.
